description: Pre-trade risk check for a Hyperliquid perp (crypto, or HIP-3 stock/index perps like xyz:NVDA). Returns liquidation price and distance in daily volatility, slippage vs the live book, funding cost, liquidity and risk flags. Neutral calculation, not advice. Inputs: coin, side (long|short), size_usd, leverage. Price: $0.005 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

coin.description: Hyperliquid market, e.g. BTC or xyz:NVDA

name: perp_risk_check
